<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Subscription service" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>enter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>receive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>cancel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>continued</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="system" name="System">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>generate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>assign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>trigger</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="support" name="Support team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>process</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>apply</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>deactivate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>settle</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Customer signs up" />
    <bpmn:task id="enter" name="Enter personal and payment information" />
    <bpmn:task id="generate" name="Generate account" />
    <bpmn:task id="assign" name="Assign access" />
    <bpmn:task id="trigger" name="Trigger automated billing cycles" />
    <bpmn:task id="receive" name="Receive updates and notifications" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="cancel" name="Customer cancels?" />
    <bpmn:task id="submit" name="Submit cancellation request" />
    <bpmn:task id="process" name="Process cancellation request" />
    <bpmn:task id="apply" name="Apply refunds or charges" />
    <bpmn:task id="deactivate" name="Deactivate subscription" />
    <bpmn:task id="settle" name="Settle final account balance" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="done" name="Subscription closed" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="continued" name="Subscription continues" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="enter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="enter" targetRef="generate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="generate" targetRef="assign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="assign" targetRef="trigger" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="trigger" targetRef="receive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="receive" targetRef="cancel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="yes" sourceRef="cancel" targetRef="submit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" name="no" sourceRef="cancel" targetRef="continued" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="submit" targetRef="process" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="process" targetRef="apply" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="apply" targetRef="deactivate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="deactivate" targetRef="settle" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="settle" targetRef="done" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
